confirmedFindings.title: Rating Cost Precision Reduction Causes Cumulative Invoicing Errors
confirmedFindings.body: Rounding call costs to 2 decimal places during rating causes sub-cent micro-rate calls (e.g. wholesale $0.004/min VoIP routing) to truncate to $0.00, resulting in catastrophic uncollected revenue across high call volumes.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Preserve high precision (minimum 6 decimal places) in intermediate rating calculations and round only on monthly invoice totals.
